en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a comedy movie
Watch a horror movie
Watch an anime movie

Yeah, it's nice to be able to watch 
light movies.

Oh, I said light, but I've got respect 
for all the work that goes into them.

I meant lighthearted. Like, you can 
relax as you watch them.
That was close. I nearly misspoke.

I can't have people misunderstanding 
just how much I love fiction.

I'm fine with that, but...are you 
okay with scary stuff, Shuichi?

I actually watched this one 
with a friend before.

I was totally fine, but she 
was in tears...
It almost felt like I was bullying her...

I don't want anything like that to 
happen, so I'm going to pass...

Well yeah. With me, that'd be 
the obvious choice.

No, I'm not upset. The truth is that 
most of the things I watch are anime.

Besides, you suggested it because 
you like anime too. Right, Shuichi?

Alright, let's stay up all night 
watching all my favorite anime!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tsumugi's inner thoughts...?
